About Us

Specialised support for the real sector of the Nigerian economy

Folybim Engineering Nigeria Limited contributes to the development of the real sector of the Nigerian economy through the provision of specialised support services.

We serve engineering, telecommunications, oil and gas, manufacturing, finance and allied companies, combining technical expertise with a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.
